name: Listening for meaning
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners listen actively, identify key points and respond to spoken ideas.

name: Collaborative discussion
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners build on contributions and use talk to shape shared understanding.

name: Presenting information
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners organise and communicate information clearly for a chosen audience.

name: Locating information
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners find relevant details from texts, diagrams, sources and digital materials.

name: Inference and deduction
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners use evidence to read between the lines and justify interpretations.
example_classroom_opportunities: Character evidence grid|Historical source inference|Scientific explanation reading

name: Comparing sources
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners compare viewpoints, reliability and purpose across sources.
example_classroom_opportunities: News comparison|Primary and secondary source check|Website reliability review

name: Planning writing
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners plan structure, content and sequence before producing written work.

name: Technical accuracy
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners edit spelling, punctuation, grammar and vocabulary choices.

name: Audience and purpose
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners adapt tone, register and form to suit the intended reader.

name: Use of calculation
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners choose and apply calculations in meaningful subject contexts.

name: Estimating and checking
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners estimate, check reasonableness and explain numerical decisions.
example_classroom_opportunities: Approximate cost planning|Data sense check|Measurement prediction

name: Financial contexts
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners apply number skills to money, value and financial decision-making.

name: Time and scale
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners use time, timelines, maps or scale to understand relationships.
example_classroom_opportunities: Historical timeline|Map scale task|Training plan timings

name: Area and volume
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners calculate, compare or reason with space, area and volume.

name: Interpreting units
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners select and interpret units accurately across practical contexts.

name: Collecting data
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners gather data fairly and record it in usable forms.

name: Representing data
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners choose appropriate charts, tables or visual displays.

name: Interpreting trends
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners describe patterns, anomalies and relationships in data.
example_classroom_opportunities: Climate trend discussion|Performance data story|Population graph analysis

name: Selecting strategies
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners choose approaches and explain why they fit the problem.
example_classroom_opportunities: Multi-step problem|Planning a route|Comparing solution methods

name: Justifying decisions
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners use numbers to support conclusions and communicate reasoning.

name: Evaluating accuracy
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners consider precision, uncertainty and reliability in numerical work.
example_classroom_opportunities: Rounding discussion|Measurement error review|Graph scale critique

name: Identity and wellbeing
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners understand their digital identity and how online choices affect wellbeing.
example_classroom_opportunities: Online profile discussion|Screen-time reflection|Digital footprint check

name: Digital rights
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners recognise ownership, permission and responsible use of digital content.
example_classroom_opportunities: Copyright check|Image permission task|Creative Commons review

name: Online behaviour
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners communicate respectfully and safely in digital spaces.
example_classroom_opportunities: Comment protocol|Shared document etiquette|Online scenario sort

name: Communication
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners select appropriate digital communication tools and formats.
example_classroom_opportunities: Email for audience|Video update|Class discussion board

name: Collaboration
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners use shared tools to co-create, review and improve work.
example_classroom_opportunities: Shared slide deck|Collaborative planning board|Peer feedback document

name: Storing and sharing
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners organise, name and share digital files responsibly.

name: Planning digital products
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners plan digital outputs with audience, purpose and success criteria in mind.

name: Creating digital content
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners combine media and tools to create purposeful digital outcomes.

name: Evaluating outputs
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners review digital work against purpose and make improvements.

name: Problem solving
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners break problems into steps and develop logical approaches.

name: Data handling
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners collect, structure and use data with digital tools.

name: Modelling
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners use digital models or simulations to test ideas.

name: Healthy relationships
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners explore respect, consent, communication and wellbeing in age-appropriate ways.
example_classroom_opportunities: Scenario discussion|Trusted adults map|Respectful language task

name: Rights and equity
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners consider rights, fairness and inclusion in relationships and communities.

name: Personal identity
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners reflect on identity, values and belonging.

name: Voice and participation
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners understand how people can participate and have their voices heard.
example_classroom_opportunities: School council brief|Campaign design|Public consultation role-play

name: Fairness
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners explore fair treatment and decision-making.
example_classroom_opportunities: Resource allocation task|Justice debate|Case study review

name: Dignity
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners consider dignity, respect and the rights of others.

name: Identity
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners explore identity as complex, personal and connected to community.

name: Culture and community
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners investigate cultures, languages and communities in Wales and beyond.

name: Challenging stereotypes
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners identify stereotypes and consider how to challenge them.

name: Pathways
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners understand possible learning and career pathways.

name: Workplace skills
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners identify transferable skills used in different roles.

name: Future planning
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners connect current learning to future choices and aspirations.
